stem.text: Alcohol X gives a yellow precipitate with alkaline $\text{I}_2\text{(aq)}$.
What is the structure of X?

A.alt: Skeletal structure of a cyclohexanol ring carrying an OH group and two methyl groups.

B.alt: Skeletal structure of a cyclohexane ring carrying a CH2OH group and a methyl branch.

C.alt: Skeletal structure of a cyclohexane ring with one ring carbon bearing both an OH group and a methyl group, plus a methyl branch.

D.alt: Skeletal structure of a cyclohexane ring with a CH(OH)CH3 side chain.
